issues.title: Preserve large identifiers and fail closed on imprecise values
issues.description: The independent validator observed topic view rounding a 28-digit topic ID in the request path and response integers. Preserve exact supported values and prevent unsafe numeric inputs or workflow artifacts from selecting a different target.

scenarioOrExplorationRef: D02 topic-view large integer synthetic exploration
source.actualOutputSummary: The initial fixture returned 404 before the topic request. A separately preserved follow-up sent the 28-digit topic ID as rounded scientific notation and emitted rounded response integers with exit 0.
source.expectedUserOutcome: Transmit and display supported identifiers and response values without precision loss; reject unsupported unsafe values before they can select another record.

issues.title: Prevent diagnostic output from exposing URL credentials
issues.description: The independent validator observed simulated credentials from the active profile URL in a doctor snapshot JSON follow-up. Sanitize applicable diagnostic output while preserving the underlying request target.

source.actualOutputSummary: The first attempt did not exercise JSON output. A separately retained JSON follow-up reported simulated URL key, Authorization, and Cookie values in config.activeProfile.baseUrl; the retained output was redacted by the validator.
source.expectedUserOutcome: Sanitize recognizable credentials in support diagnostics and prevent displayed profile URL components from exposing userinfo, queries, or fragments.

issues.title: Preserve the supplied decimal user ID and enforce its length
issues.description: A fresh independent validator observed operations-v2 removing a leading zero from a 28-digit input before constructing the request. The API declares an integer, so this observation does not establish an incorrect numeric account selection; preserve the supplied valid spelling and enforce the documented input length.

scenarioOrExplorationRef: D07 leading-zero user ID synthetic exploration
source.actualOutputSummary: The first attempt did not reach the aggregate route because the synthetic fixture path was wrong. A retained follow-up showed a 28-digit input beginning with zero sent with that zero removed; the reported integer value is equivalent and no wrong-user selection was demonstrated.
source.expectedUserOutcome: For a supported 1–28 digit positive decimal user ID, preserve the supplied digits in the request without rounding; reject overlength input before network access.

issues.title: Bind workflow verification, approval and execution to the original preview
issues.description: An independent validator changed a preview request body while retaining its payload hash; workflow verify reported no issues and a follow-up approval accepted the changed request. Preserve and validate preview integrity and avoid sending a different request after approval checks.

source.actualOutputSummary: The first verification reported ok with zero issues after preview content changed while payloadHash stayed unchanged; a separately retained approval follow-up accepted that changed request. No execution or real write was performed. The first-attempt aggregate output digest did not match the separately retained output files, so its independent integrity remains limited.
source.expectedUserOutcome: Reject altered previews before approval and verification, and ensure execution sends only the same request that was approved.

enhancementRequests.title: Expose compatible administrator operations v2
currentBehavior: The production API advertises administrator operations v2, while the CLI exposes only the v1 aggregate and its keyword output.
English APEX search returned HTTP 500 and the community OpenAPI YAML failed to parse during the 2026-11-05 audit.
Independent baseline testing observed HTTP 400 for a v2 request without limit on the candidate DEV endpoint, although the documented default is 20; explicit 10, 20, 50 and 100 succeeded.
requiredOutcomes: Investigate and repair the server search failure and API contract in the server-owned task, retaining first-failure and environment evidence.
Expose operations v2 through an explicit backwards-compatible CLI command, with a separate schema, capability checks and documented v1/v2 semantics.
Freeze the exact candidate and pass the applicable baseline plus dynamic real-scenario validation in a fresh independent apexcn-cli-test task.

server.requiredWhen: APEX application or ORDS REST API capability is missing or incorrect
